_comment: sim-release-threshold-carton-frame-v1 (coldwin87 + coldwin83/85/86). TWO fixes for the collect cart/shelf set-down release, so the complete restock run ends with the carton proven parallel-to-ground (<=2.0 deg, never loosened) and resting at TRUE shelf contact. FIX 1 (threshold frame, automatic -- no new key): the geometric contact-release threshold now fires at the TRUE contact. FIX 2 (release_free_check, opt-in): after the detach, PROVE the carton is free of the gripper and resting, then clear the gripper straight up before any lateral/pan retreat. ON values below are for coldwin89.
_root_cause_threshold: carton_z (sensors.placed_pose[2]) is the carton CENTRE (types.py Sensors.placed_pose). coldwin87 PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_ARM: 'start_carton_z=0.6422 descent_drop=0.0907 gap=0.0120 -> release at carton_z<=0.5635'. The legacy threshold start_carton_z - drop + gap = 0.5635 expressed the carton BOTTOM frame (support_top + gap), but the controller compared it against the measured carton CENTRE, so it sat the carton HALF-height too low: the welded carton rested on the shelf at carton_z 0.6422 (the PLACE_RELEASE_TICK plateau; 0.0787 m ~ half 0.09 - gap 0.012 ABOVE 0.5635). With PR 373's startup-stall suppression on (place_release_stall_height_margin_m=0.02), the STALL trigger could not fire either, so the stiff place drive pressed the welded carton into the shelf -> STATION_FULL_BRAKE_EFFORT -> PATH_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED (1.300 rad) -> HOST_FAULT_ESTOP. The stall was the REAL contact all along.
_fix_threshold: carton_level.place_contact_release_z_centre adds the carton half-height (handling_unit height 0.18 / 2 = 0.09) so the threshold is in the SAME (carton CENTRE) frame as the measured carton pose. cw87: 0.6422 - 0.0907 + 0.09 + 0.012 = 0.6535 -> the geometric z trigger fires at the measured rest (carton BOTTOM at support_top + gap), CONSISTENT with the stall trigger, instead of 0.078 m below it. AUTOMATIC within the already-opt-in place_contact_release / place_release_on_contact mechanism: no new config key, byte-identical when that mechanism is off.
_pr373_margin_must_stay_off: KEEP PR 373's place_release_stall_height_margin_m OFF (absent / null). It suppressed the render-paced startup stall but, with the threshold frame now corrected, the STALL trigger fires at the true contact the SAME place the z trigger does, so the margin is no longer needed AND must not be set: with it on, the startup-stall suppression combined with the (previously) too-low z threshold is exactly what pressed cw87 into the shelf. Leave it off so the stall trigger is the honest fast path and the corrected z trigger is the fallback.
_root_cause_falls: coldwin85 and coldwin86 released the weld at the set-down (trigger=stall) and the retreat's first motion swept the barely-rested carton off the shelf -> verify 'carton not resting on deck' (cw85 xy=1.219 bottom_gap=-0.954, cw86 xy=1.220 bottom_gap=-0.815 -> on the floor). coldwin83 on the SAME config happened to rest (verify passed). The fall was a RETREAT problem -- the open gripper still cradled the carton and the lateral fold carried/tipped it off -- not a release-height problem.
_fix_falls: carton_level.release_free_check (release_free.ReleaseFreeGate): after the confirmed weld detach, HOLD (no retreat motion) until the measured carton CENTRE z is stable AND the carton BOTTOM is resting (|bottom_gap| <= release_free_rest_gap_m) for release_free_settle_ticks consecutive ticks, THEN raise the gripper straight up by release_free_lift_dz_m (a pure vertical clearance lift, reusing the collect retreat lift-off IK) before any lateral / pan retreat motion, and verify the carton did NOT follow the gripper up (rose < release_free_follow_frac of the lift). FAILS BY NAME (RELEASE_NOT_FREE) if the carton never rests within release_free_settle_window_ticks or follows the gripper. Needs a measured placed_pose (RESTOCK_VERIFY_PLACE); absent => the check is skipped (real rig). Logs RELEASE_FREE_BEGIN / RELEASE_FREE_LIFT / RELEASE_FREE_CLEAR.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> carton_level.resolve_level_config -> TransferController; validated by LevelConfig.validate, a bad value fails loudly at boot -- no new config_preflight registration). Keep the run's existing carton_level keys; only release_free_check (+ its tuning) is added, and place_release_stall_height_margin_m is REMOVED (back to off).

carton_level._existing: Keep the coldwin89 carton_level keys (place_release_on_contact:true, place_contact_release, place_contact_gap_m:0.012, closed_loop_*, place_from_above, gravity_compensation, release_cancel_handshake:true, release_reissue:true, place_release_stall_m / place_release_stall_ticks, place_support_tokens, ...). The threshold frame fix is AUTOMATIC inside place_release_on_contact / place_contact_release -- no key change.
carton_level._place_release_stall_height_margin_m_not: OFF (null / absent). PR 373's startup-stall margin is retired by this change -- with the corrected threshold the stall trigger fires at the true contact, and leaving the margin on reintroduces the cw87 press. Must stay off.
carton_level._release_free_check_note: THE SECONDARY FIX. After the weld detach, prove the carton is free+resting before retreating and clear the gripper straight up first; refuse RELEASE_NOT_FREE if the carton follows the gripper. Default off => the detach transitions straight to retreat => byte-identical. Scoped to the release phase, only when a measured placed_pose is available.
carton_level._tuning_note: release_free_settle_ticks consecutive ticks where the carton CENTRE z moves <= release_free_stable_eps_m (5 mm) AND the carton bottom is within release_free_rest_gap_m (30 mm) of the support top = 'free and resting'. release_free_settle_window_ticks (60) bounds the hold before RELEASE_NOT_FREE. release_free_lift_dz_m (60 mm) is the pure vertical clearance lift before any lateral retreat; a carton that rises >= release_free_follow_frac (50%) of it with the gripper is still held -> RELEASE_NOT_FREE. rest_gap_m is comfortably inside the verify z-tol (RESTOCK_PLACE_VERIFY_Z_TOL 0.12) so a carton the free-check accepts also passes verify.

_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the coldwin87 config (the full cold restock cycle through the collect cart set-down + release + retreat + verify) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with place_release_stall_height_margin_m REMOVED and release_free_check:true merged into the HOST carton_level block. Expected PASS (coldwin89-class): PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE_ARM now prints 'release at carton_z(centre)<=~0.6535 (fire at true contact: carton BOTTOM at support_top + gap, carton CENTRE + half-height)'; the welded carton descends level, the release fires (trigger=stall or z) at the TRUE rest where the carton sets down on the shelf (NOT a press to STATION_FULL_BRAKE / PATH_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED); RELEASE_FREE_BEGIN -> the carton reads stable + resting (bottom_gap ~0) -> RELEASE_FREE_LIFT raises the gripper +0.06 m -> RELEASE_FREE_CLEAR (carton stayed) -> retreat; the collect verify reads xy within RESTOCK_PLACE_VERIFY_XY_TOL (0.25) and |bottom_gap| within RESTOCK_PLACE_VERIFY_Z_TOL (0.12) -- 'place verification' PASSES with the carton parallel to the ground (<=2.0 deg, never loosened). If the carton genuinely cannot rest (a real obstruction) or follows the gripper up, RELEASE_NOT_FREE fails by name rather than sweeping/carrying it off the shelf.
